technical.summary: Strong bullish technicals with price at new highs and all moving averages aligned, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 88+, Stoch 93.5) and absence of fresh crossover signals suggest limited upside momentum and elevated pullback risk.

fundamental.summary: MO shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying data, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 7 days present elevated volatility risk with no fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (26/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and non-directional with only small purchases by junior members; lack of recent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds (crisis VIX, flat yield curve, rising dollar) combined with imminent earnings binary event create elevated risk environment for MO.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price at 52-week highs with all major moving averages aligned, three white soldiers pattern, and supertrend bullish creates textbook bullish setup in extreme fear environment (VIX crisis) offering contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 88+, Stoch 93.5) combined with critical earnings binary within 7 days, zero fundamental support, no insider conviction, and severe macro headwinds (crisis VIX, rising dollar, flat yield curve) create unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.
